evidence_level: revealed 32-image development upper bound; not a deployable selector

selection_rule.grounding: choose the resolution with higher ground-truth IoU
selection_rule.pointing: choose the resolution with lower ground-truth bbox-normalized point error

cost_boundary.one_shot: only the selected resolution is encoded
cost_boundary.active_escalation: low resolution is encoded first; selected high resolution is then re-encoded and both token counts are charged
